title: DOJ: trial under Military Order Number One

tellings.quote: the DOJ said that I'd be tried under military order number one, which is Guantanamo status.

plain: A British computer hacker named Gary McKinnon, who says he broke into NASA and US military systems and found signs of a secret space program, says the US Department of Justice told him he would be tried under Military Order Number One. In his words that meant "Guantanamo status," the treatment given to terror suspects held at the US military prison in Cuba. He tells it to show how seriously, and how harshly, the US government reacted to what he did in the 2000s.
